basic_details.job_title: Delhi University Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Junior Hindi Translator, Legal Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification, the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 20 November 2026, or within two weeks from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News, whichever is later

qualification.details: Junior Hindi Translator - Pay Level- 06 | Essential Qualifications: | Master’s degree of a recognized University in Hindi with English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master’s Degree of a recognized University in English with Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master’s Degree of a recognized University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi medium and English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master’s Degree of a recognized University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with English Medium and Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject or as a medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master’s Degree of a recognized University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi and English as a compulsory or elective subjects or either of the two as a medium of examination and the other as a compulsory or elective subject at the degree level. AND Recognized Diploma or Certificate course in translation from Hindi to English & vice versa or two years’ experience of translation work from Hindi to English and vice versa in Central or State Government Office, including Government of India Undertaking. Studied one of the languages other than Hindi included in the 8th Schedule of the Constitution at 10th level from a recognized board. | Age Limit: 35 years | Legal Assistant - Pay Level- 06 | Essential Qualifications: | Degree in Law (Professional) from a recognized University. Minimum 3 years of experience in handling court cases in a government/semi-government organization and/or practice before a High Court or a Lower Court in Civil/Labour matters. | Desirable | Post-Graduate Degree. Diploma in IPR or Labour Laws. Good drafting and noting skills and knowledge of service rules applicable to Central Government employees. Hands on experience in computers. | Age Limit: 40 years

how_to_apply: Go to the University website, www.du.ac.in.
Click Work with DU and look under the head "Advertisement - Departments" for the details of Advt. No. R&P/326/2026.
Submit your application online in the prescribed Application Form before the last date.

content_sections.heading: DU Junior Hindi Translator and Legal Assistant Vacancy Details 2026
DU Junior Hindi Translator and Legal Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Junior Hindi Translator - Pay Level- 06 Essential Qualifications: Master’s degree of a recognized University in Hindi with English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master’s Degree of a recognized University in English with Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master’s Degree of a recognized University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi medium and English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master’s Degree of a recognized University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with English Medium and Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject or as a medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master’s Degree of a recognized University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi and English as a compulsory or elective subjects or either of the two as a medium of examination and the other as a compulsory or elective subject at the degree level. AND Recognized Diploma or Certificate course in translation from Hindi to English & vice versa or two years’ experience of translation work from Hindi to English and vice versa in Central or State Government Office, including Government of India Undertaking. Studied one of the languages other than Hindi included in the 8th Schedule of the Constitution at 10th level from a recognized board. Age Limit: 35 years Legal Assistant - Pay Level- 06 Essential Qualifications: Degree in Law (Professional) from a recognized University. Minimum 3 years of experience in handling court cases in a government/semi-government organization and/or practice before a High Court or a Lower Court in Civil/Labour matters. Desirable Post-Graduate Degree. Diploma in IPR or Labour Laws. Good drafting and noting skills and knowledge of service rules applicable to Central Government employees. Hands on experience in computers. Age Limit: 40 years

faq.question: Q1. What are the post codes for these jobs?
faq.answer: Junior Hindi Translator is Post Code ND0601 and Legal Assistant is Post Code ND0602.

faq.question: Q2. Are any of these vacancies reserved for SC, ST, OBC or EWS candidates?
faq.answer: No. All 2 Junior Hindi Translator vacancies and the 1 Legal Assistant vacancy are listed under UR, with 00 shown for SC, ST, OBC and EWS.

faq.question: Q3. Can the deadline fall after 20 November 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. If two weeks from the advertisement's publication in the Employment News ends later than 20 November 2026, that later date applies.

faq.question: Q4. Do both posts have the same pay level?
faq.answer: Yes. Junior Hindi Translator and Legal Assistant are both at Pay Level 06 under the VII CPC.

faq.question: Q5. Where will changes to this advertisement be published?
faq.answer: Any addendum or corrigendum to Advt. No. R&P/326/2026 will be posted on the website only, so check the University website for updates.
